title: Band glute bridge
steps: Lie on your back with the band looped just above your knees.
Bend your knees and set your feet flat, hip-width apart.
Push through your feet and lift your hips until your body makes a straight line.
Press your knees gently apart against the band.
Lower slowly and repeat. Do 2 sets of 10.
mistakes: Pushing your ribs up instead of lifting from the hips.
Letting your knees fall together against the band.
